WITH CNT_CARD_NBR AS (
SELECT
    COUNT(CARD_NBR) as COUNT
    ,CARD_ACCT_NBR
    ,CARD_SUP_REL
    ,CARD_CUST_NBR
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARDP
group by CARD_ACCT_NBR, CARD_SUP_REL, CARD_CUST_NBR

)
,TEMP_DMCardMaster
AS(
SELECT
CED.CARD_ACCT_NBR AS Account_Number
,CED.CARD_SUP_REL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,NULL as Customer_Local_Name
,NULL as Customer_Number
,CED.CARD_NBR AS Card_Number
,NULL as Valid_Card_Tag
,NULL as Account_Block_Code
,CED.CARD_BLK_CODE AS Card_Block_Code
,NULL as General_Status -- for expression update
,CED.CARD_PDT_NBR AS Product_Code
,CASE WHEN GRT.DATA_MART_FIELD  = 'PROD_TYPE'
THEN
CASE
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR = 100 THEN 'GOLD'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (101, 102, 103, 104, 105) THEN 'PRIME'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 207, 208, 209, 210, 211) THEN 'PLATINUM'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306) THEN 'WORLD'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (308, 309, 310) THEN 'WEALTH' 
END
END AS Product_Type
,CASE WHEN GRT.DATA_MART_FIELD  = 'PROD_TYPE2'
THEN
CASE
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (101, 102, 103, 104, 105) THEN 'PRIME'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (202, 203, 204, 205) THEN 'PLATINUM'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (201, 206, 207, 208, 209) THEN 'CASH REWARDS'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (210, 211) THEN 'FREEDOM'
    WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306, 308, 309, 310) THEN 'WORLD'
END
END AS Product_Type2
,CASE WHEN GRT.DATA_MART_FIELD  = 'PROD_VARIANT' THEN
GRT.Description 
END AS  Product_Variant
,CED.CARD_FORMAT_ID AS Card_Format_ID
,CASE
        WHEN CED.CARD_FORMAT_ID = '0008' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL as Account_Activated_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN CED.CARD_BLK_CODE NOT IN ('NC', 'NW') THEN 1
        WHEN CED.CARD_BLK_CODE IN ('NC', 'NW') THEN 0
    END AS Card_Activated_Tag
,CASE
       WHEN CCN.COUNT > 1 THEN 1
       ELSE 0
    END AS WITH_REPLACEMENT_TAG
,NULL as CONVERTED_TAG -- for expression update
,NULL as OPEN_TAG -- for expression update
,NULL as Test_Card_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN CED.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (101, 102, 201, 202, 209, 302, 310) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS ECP_TAG
,NULL as ECC_Tag
,NULL as  VIP_Tag
,NULL as Secured_Tag
,NULL as Depositor_Tag
,NULL as CIF_Number
,NULL as Auto_Debit_Tag
,NULL as DOSRI_Tag
,NULL as RPT_Tag
,NULL as Account_Open_Date
,CED.CARD_DTE_OPEN AS Card_Open_Date
,CED.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,CED.CARD_EXPIRY AS Card_Expiry
,NULL as Account_Block_Code_Date
,CED.CARD_DTE_BLK_CODE AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,CED.CARD_ACTIVATION_UPD AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,NULL as Source_Code
,NULL as Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS COUNT -- for expression update
,NULL AS Sequence -- for expression update
,NULL as [SET]
,CED.CARD_SUP_REL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARDP CED
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_GENREFTABLES GRT
ON Convert(varchar,CED.CARD_PDT_NBR) = Convert(varchar,GRT.Code)
LEFT JOIN CNT_CARD_NBR CCN 
ON CED.CARD_ACCT_NBR = CCN.CARD_ACCT_NBR  AND CED.CARD_SUP_REL = CCN.CARD_SUP_REL and CED.CARD_CUST_NBR = CCN.CARD_CUST_NBR
WHERE CED.ISLATEST = 1

UNION ALL
SELECT
CEF.CARD_ACCT_NBR AS Account_Number
,CEF.CARD_SUP_REL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,NULL as Customer_Local_Name
,NULL as Customer_Number
,CEF.CARD_NBR AS Card_Number
,NULL as Valid_Card_Tag
,NULL as Account_Block_Code
,CEF.CARD_BLK_CODE AS Card_Block_Code
,NULL as General_Status -- for expression update
,CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR AS Product_Code
,CASE WHEN GRT.DATA_MART_FIELD  = 'PROD_TYPE'
THEN
CASE
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR = 100 THEN 'GOLD'
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (101, 102, 103, 104, 105) THEN 'PRIME'
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (201, 202, 203, 204, 205, 206, 207, 208, 209, 210, 211) THEN 'PLATINUM'
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306) THEN 'WORLD'
        WHEN PaymentCardTypeId IN (308, 309, 310) THEN 'WEALTH' -- PaymentCardTypeId for confirmation
END
END AS Product_Type
,CASE WHEN GRT.DATA_MART_FIELD  = 'PROD_TYPE2'
THEN
CASE
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (101, 102, 103, 104, 105) THEN 'PRIME'
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (202, 203, 204, 205) THEN 'PLATINUM'
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (201, 206, 207, 208, 209) THEN 'CASH REWARDS'
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (210, 211) THEN 'FREEDOM'
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306, 308, 309, 310) THEN 'WORLD'
END
END AS Product_Type2
,CASE WHEN GRT.DATA_MART_FIELD  = 'PROD_VARIANT' THEN
GRT.Description 
END AS  Product_Variant
,CEF.CARD_FORMAT_ID AS Card_Format_ID
,CASE
        WHEN CEF.CARD_FORMAT_ID = '0008' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL as Account_Activated_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN CEF.CARD_BLK_CODE NOT IN ('NC', 'NW') THEN 1
        WHEN CEF.CARD_BLK_CODE IN ('NC', 'NW') THEN 0
    END AS Card_Activated_Tag
,CASE
       WHEN CCN.COUNT > 1 THEN 1
       ELSE 0
    END AS WITH_REPLACEMENT_TAG
,NULL as CONVERTED_TAG -- for expression update
,NULL as OPEN_TAG -- for expression update
,NULL as Test_Card_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR IN (101, 102, 201, 202, 209, 302, 310) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS ECP_TAG
,NULL as ECC_Tag
,NULL as  VIP_Tag
,NULL as Secured_Tag
,NULL as Depositor_Tag
,NULL as CIF_Number
,NULL as Auto_Debit_Tag
,NULL as DOSRI_Tag
,NULL as RPT_Tag
,NULL as Account_Open_Date
,CEF.CARD_DTE_OPEN AS Card_Open_Date
,CEF.CARD_LST_RENEW_DATE AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,CEF.CARD_EXPIRY AS Card_Expiry
,NULL as Account_Block_Code_Date
,CEF.CARD_DTE_BLK_CODE AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,CEF.CARD_ACTIVATION_UPD AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,NULL as Source_Code
,NULL as Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS COUNT -- for expression update
,NULL AS Sequence -- for expression update
,NULL as SET
,CEF.CARD_SUP_REL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARFP CEF
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_GENREFTABLES GRT
ON Convert(varchar,CEF.CARD_PDT_NBR) = Convert(varchar,GRT.Code)
LEFT JOIN CNT_CARD_NBR CCN 
ON CED.CARD_ACCT_NBR = CCN.CARD_ACCT_NBR  AND CED.CARD_SUP_REL = CCN.CARD_SUP_REL and CED.CARD_CUST_NBR = CCN.CARD_CUST_NBR
WHERE CEF.ISLATEST = 1

UNION ALL
SELECT 
NULL AS Account_Number
,NULL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME AS Customer_Local_Name
,DC.CUST_NBR AS Customer_Number
,NULL AS Card_Number
,NULL AS Valid_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code
,NULL AS General_Status
,NULL AS Product_Code
,NULL AS Product_Type
,NULL AS Product_Type2
,NULL AS Product_Variant
,NULL AS Card_Format_ID
,NULL AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS Card_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS With_Replacement_Tag
,NULL AS Converted_Tag
,NULL AS Open_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN
            CHARINDEX('TEST0', DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TEST ', DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TESTC', DC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            LEFT(CCEC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('TES', 'TST', 'XXX') THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Test_Card_Tag
,NULL AS ECP_Tag
,NULL AS ECC_Tag
,NULL AS VIP_Tag
,NULL AS Secured_Tag
,NULL AS Depositor_Tag
,DC.CUST_CIF_NBR AS CIF_Number
,NULL AS Auto_Debit_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN DC.CUST_RELATION IN (1, 2) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS DOSRI_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN DC.CUST_RELATION IN (5, 6) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS RPT_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,NULL AS Card_Expiry
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,NULL AS Source_Code
,NULL AS Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS [Count]
,NULL AS [Sequence]
,NULL AS [Set]
,NULL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER DC
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP CCEC ON DC.CUST_NBR = CCEC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
WHERE DC.ISLATEST = 1

UNION ALL
SELECT 
NULL AS Account_Number
,NULL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME AS Customer_Local_Name
,MC.CUST_NBR AS Customer_Number
,NULL AS Card_Number
,NULL AS Valid_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code
,NULL AS General_Status
,NULL AS Product_Code
,NULL AS Product_Type
,NULL AS Product_Type2
,NULL AS Product_Variant
,NULL AS Card_Format_ID
,NULL AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS Card_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS With_Replacement_Tag
,NULL AS Converted_Tag
,NULL AS Open_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN
            CHARINDEX('TEST0', MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TEST ', MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
            CHARINDEX('TESTC', MC.CUST_LOCAL_NAME) > 0 OR
              LEFT(CCECP.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('TES', 'TST', 'XXX')
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Test_Card_Tag
,NULL AS ECP_Tag
,NULL AS ECC_Tag
,NULL AS VIP_Tag
,NULL AS Secured_Tag
,NULL AS Depositor_Tag
,MC.CUST_CIF_NBR AS CIF_Number
,NULL AS Auto_Debit_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN MC.CUST_RELATION IN (1, 2) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS DOSRI_Tag
, CASE
        WHEN MC.CUST_RELATION IN (5, 6) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS RPT_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,NULL AS Card_Expiry
,NULL AS Account_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,NULL AS Source_Code
,NULL AS Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS [Count]
,NULL AS [Sequence]
,NULL AS [Set]
,NULL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER MC
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP CCECP ON MC.CUST_NBR = CCECP.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR
WHERE MC.ISLATEST = 1


UNION ALL
SELECT 
NULL AS Account_Number
,NULL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,NULL AS Customer_Local_Name
,NULL AS Customer_Number
,NULL AS Card_Number
,NULL AS Valid_Card_Tag
,CEC.CRDACCT_BLK_CODE AS Account_Block_Code
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code 
,NULL AS General_Status -- for expression update
,NULL AS Product_Code
,NULL AS Product_Type
,NULL AS Product_Type2
,NULL AS Product_Variant
,NULL AS Card_Format_ID
,NULL AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS Card_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS With_Replacement_Tag
,NULL AS Converted_Tag
,NULL AS Open_Tag
,NULL AS Test_Card_Tag
,NULL AS ECP_Tag
,NULL AS ECC_Tag
,NULL AS VIP_Tag
,CASE
        WHEN LEFT(CEC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('HOA', 'TCB') 
             AND CEC.CRDACCT_HOLD_ACCOUNT <> 'UNSECURED' 
             AND CEC.CRDACCT_HOLD_AMOUNT > 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Secured_Tag
 ,CASE
        WHEN LEFT(CEC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('ACC','BDO','BTR','BWI','CAP','CRP','CRT','DOB','KCM','KCS','LGC','MGM','REC','REG','SOE','SUP','SVD','TES','TPD','TPE') THEN 0
        WHEN LEFT(CEC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('BDD','BLG','BRP','BRR','BRT','DPI','DPV','HOA','LSA','LSB') THEN 1
        WHEN LEFT(CEC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('ECP','PAY','SAP','ECC','ABL','HBL','NTH','NTV','PBR') THEN 2
        ELSE 2
    END AS DEPOSITOR_TAG
,NULL AS CIF_NUMBER
, CASE
        WHEN CEC.CRDACCT_DD_ACC IN ('', '.', ' ') THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END AS Auto_Debit_Tag
,NULL AS DOSRI_Tag
,NULL AS RPT_Tag
,CEC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS Account_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,NULL AS Card_Expiry
,CEC.CRDACCT_DTE_BLK_CODE AS Account_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,CEC.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE AS Source_Code
,CEC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS [Count]
,NULL AS [Sequence]
,NULL AS [Set]
,NULL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP CEC 
WHERE CEC.ISLATEST = 1

UNION ALL
SELECT 
NULL AS Account_Number
,NULL AS Card_Relationship_Indicator
,NULL AS Customer_Local_Name
,NULL AS Customer_Number
,NULL AS Card_Number
,NULL AS Valid_Card_Tag
,CEFP.CRDACCT_BLK_CODE AS Account_Block_Code
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code 
,NULL AS General_Status -- for expression update
,NULL AS Product_Code
,NULL AS Product_Type
,NULL AS Product_Type2
,NULL AS Product_Variant
,NULL AS Card_Format_ID
,NULL AS Virtual_Card_Tag
,NULL AS Account_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS Card_Activated_Tag
,NULL AS With_Replacement_Tag
,NULL AS Converted_Tag
,NULL AS Open_Tag
,NULL AS Test_Card_Tag
,NULL AS ECP_Tag
,NULL AS ECC_Tag
,NULL AS VIP_Tag
,CASE
        WHEN LEFT(CEFP.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('HOA', 'TCB') 
             AND CEFP.CRDACCT_HOLD_ACCOUNT <> 'UNSECURED' 
             AND CEFP.CRDACCT_HOLD_AMOUNT > 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS Secured_Tag
 ,CASE
        WHEN LEFT(CEFP.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('ACC','BDO','BTR','BWI','CAP','CRP','CRT','DOB','KCM','KCS','LGC','MGM','REC','REG','SOE','SUP','SVD','TES','TPD','TPE') THEN 0
        WHEN LEFT(CEFP.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('BDD','BLG','BRP','BRR','BRT','DPI','DPV','HOA','LSA','LSB') THEN 1
        WHEN LEFT(CEFP.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE, 3) IN ('ECP','PAY','SAP','ECC','ABL','HBL','NTH','NTV','PBR') THEN 2
        ELSE 2
    END AS DEPOSITOR_TAG
,NULL AS CIF_NUMBER
, CASE
        WHEN CEFP.CRDACCT_DD_ACC IN ('', '.', ' ') THEN 0
        ELSE 1
    END AS Auto_Debit_Tag
,NULL AS DOSRI_Tag
,NULL AS RPT_Tag
,CEFP.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS Account_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Open_Date
,NULL AS Card_Last_Renewal_Date
,NULL AS Card_Expiry
,CEFP.CRDACCT_DTE_BLK_CODE AS Account_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Block_Code_Date
,NULL AS Card_Activation_Date_Updated
,CEFP.CRDACCT_APPL_SRC_CODE AS Source_Code
,CEFP.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS Account_Credit_Limit
,NULL AS [Count]
,NULL AS [Sequence]
,NULL AS [Set]
,NULL AS Orig_Cardholder_Type
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP CEFP 
WHERE CEFP.ISLATEST = 1
)
